  </div>
</div></div></div><div class="fe-block fe-block-568d8aa8c0023718a7ac"><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-html html-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/45a223c2-0a7f-41e1-910b-7e4ed1931d30_973/website.components.html.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.html/45a223c2-0a7f-41e1-910b-7e4ed1931d30_973/website.components.html.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.html" data-sqsp-block="text" data-website-component-id="568d8aa8c0023718a7ac" id="block-568d8aa8c0023718a7ac"><div class="sqs-block-content"><div class="sqs-text-block-container">
  <div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Mounu Island is a remote paradise located in the stunning Vava’u archipelago of Tonga. Its seclusion is part of its charm, but getting here takes some planning. There are several routes to reach Vava’u:</p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Via New Zealand</strong>:</p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Fly from Auckland (Air New Zealand) to Nuku’alofa, then transfer to a domestic hopper flight to Vava’u.</p></li></ul></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Via Fiji</strong>:</p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Fiji Airways offers flights from Nadi to either Nuku’alofa or directly into Vava’u.</p></li></ul></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Via Australia</strong>:</p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Qantas flies from Sydney to Nuku’alofa.</p></li></ul></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Inter-island Connections</strong>:</p><ul data-rte-list="default"><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Lulutai Airlines provides domestic flights within Tonga.<br> Contact: info@lulutai-airlines.to</p></li><li><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Or reach out to Discover Tonga for assistance: support@discovertonga.org</p></li></ul></li></ul><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Once you arrive in Vava’u, it’s a 25-minute boat ride to Mounu Island.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>All guests must travel with travel insurance.</strong></p></div>
<style id="container-styles"></style>
